timing: timeline.json (measured from the full take; every beat keys on a spoken word)

motionFamilies.draw-on: a stroke drawn along its path as the idea is spoken
motionFamilies.build: parts placed one after another, never all at once
motionFamilies.morph: a shape or bar changing into its new meaning
motionFamilies.reveal: a word uncovered after the expectation is built
motionFamilies.compare: split or side-by-side, at most two things at once
motionFamilies.hold: 0.6–1.5 s of stillness for an idea that needs it

scenes.name: الخطاف — مفارقة السماعات
scenes.purpose: the paradox before second 12: the same $40 feels lighter once $200 stands next to it
scenes.visual: doodle headphones A (blue) on a red price tag «40 دولارًا»; a 'felt price' gauge beside it; headphones B (cover blue, larger) slides in with «200 دولار»; A's gauge drops while its tag stays the same
motion: draw-on A on «سماعاتٌ»
gauge fills high on «غالية»
build: B slides in on «تظهر»
draw-on: a comparison arrow from B to A on «وفجأة» (B now sets the yardstick)
morph: A's gauge falls on «أخفّ»
compare: an '=' tag lock on «لم يتغيّر»
draw-on: a green ring around A on «والسماعات» (the pair itself is the same)

scenes.name: المشكلة — ما الذي تغيّر؟
scenes.purpose: name the viewer's problem: the neighbor changed, not the product; it happens in shops, offers, yeses
scenes.visual: the two headphones as small doodles; a dashed ring jumps from A to its neighbor B; three paper cards slide in (a shop bag, a subscription card, a speech bubble «نعم»); a thought bubble asks why
motion: reveal «ما الذي تغيّر؟»
the cheaper pair shakes 'no' on «ليس السماعات»
draw-on dashed ring on «بجانبها»
the pair rises and shrinks through «وهذا يحدث معنا أكثر مما نظن» and stays above as the reference
build three collage cards on «متجر» / «اشتراك» / «نعم»; the «نعم» card wobbles on «مقتنعين»
the thought bubble opens on «نسأل»; hold on «لماذا وافقتُ؟»

scenes.name: الكتاب والفكرة
scenes.purpose: introduce the book and author briefly; mental shortcuts; name the idea
scenes.visual: an original descriptive book card (no cover image): «التأثير» / «علم نفس الإقناع» / «روبرت سيالديني»; a winding path with a straight shortcut drawn across it; a small red warning on the shortcut; the idea's name revealed
motion: build the book card from the cut
each card line is underlined as it is named («التأثير» / «الإقناع» / «روبرت سيالديني»)
draw-on: long path, then the shortcut
a dot races along the shortcut and one along the long path on «توفّر»; a green check on «تخدمنا جيدًا»
a ring on the shortcut on «واحدة منها»
a red mark pops on «تُستغَل»; two numbered cards placed on «يرتّب… نراه»
reveal «مبدأ التباين» (the card clears on «مبدأ»)
scenes.rights: no cover image; a card drawn from the title text only

scenes.name: الآلية — المسطرة والماء
scenes.purpose: the mechanism: comparison with what came just before; the water demonstration; the order makes the reference point
scenes.visual: a ruler crossed out, replaced by an arrow between two shapes; three bowls (cold, lukewarm, hot); two 'felt' gauges travel from cold and hot into the lukewarm bowl and read warm and cold while the real thermometer stays still; a three-step chain
motion: the ruler draws from the cut and is complete on «بمسطرة»; red cross on «بل»
the ruler holds through «جرّب هذا»; three bowls land one by one on «ثلاثة أوعية»
highlight rings on the cold and hot bowls as the hands go in
the felt gauges move on «انقل» and change through «اليد القادمة… / والقادمة…»
hold on «الماء واحد»
three dashed slots on «الترتيب», filled by the 3-step chain
scenes.note: no hands drawn: perceived temperature is shown by gauges

scenes.name: المثال الأول — تطوّر القرار
scenes.purpose: the decision evolving: alone vs next to $200; a $30 plan that ends at $40 while feeling like $160 saved
scenes.visual: A with a wallet and a need icon; the comparison pointer jumps from the wallet to B; a plan tag «الخطة: 30 دولارًا», the seller's order 200 → 40; split compare: the feeling «وفّرتُ 160!» against the fact «10 دولارات فوق الخطة»; a closing warning
motion: the $40 pair draws itself through «لكن لنرَ كيف يتطوّر القرار»; the «مثال افتراضي» label pops on «مثال»
a dashed ring on «وحدها»; a small need target beside the wallet on «تحتاجه»
the comparison pointer goes to the wallet on «ستقارنها»
the $200 pair arrives on «بجانب»; the pointer moves to it on «تتغيّر نقطة المقارنة»
the $40 tag dips on «صفقة» and pulses on «ثابت»; a felt gauge drops on «الإحساس به تحرّك»
build the purchase sequence word by word (plan, $200 pair, its tag, $40 pair, its tag)
compare split: feeling vs fact
on «لم يكذب عليك أحد» the feeling and fact step aside and a check marks the honest price
the order is replayed with badges 1 → 2 on «ترتيب»; badge 1 pulses on «الأغلى»
reveal the warning
on «أخفّ» the $40 tag dips; on «لا يعني أنه مناسبٌ» a need target appears with ≠ between it and the pair

scenes.name: المثال الثاني وتصحيح الفهم
scenes.purpose: same mechanism in a second everyday case; correct the misunderstanding (not naivety, not every offer a trick)
scenes.visual: a laptop «900 دولار», a case «60 دولارًا» shrinking next to it; then the case alone on a calendar day; a correction card; an arrow that the viewer's own ruler re-points
motion: two empty slots (big, small) and a comparison arrow on «والآلية نفسها»
build laptop then case into the slots
the case moves next to the laptop on «بجانب»; morph scale: 60 shrinks beside 900, regrows alone; its tag pulses on «ستين»
reveal «تصحيح مهم», then the two correction labels
a grey ruler on «نحكم» turns green on «نختر… بأنفسنا»; it dims as a red dashed outside pointer arrives on «لغيرنا»

scenes.name: التطبيق — ثلاث خطوات
scenes.purpose: three steps (need, independent yardstick, decision) and one small experiment
scenes.visual: three doodle stations built in order: a target (need), a green ruler next to a budget card (yardstick), a paper card covering the $200 headphones (decision); a small 'this week' card
motion: three dashed slots from the cut; the question «كيف تحمي قرارك؟» on «فكيف»
numbers 1–3 pop on «ثلاث خطوات»
build step 1, 2, 3 on «الحاجة» / «معيار» / «القرار»; small pulses on «أحتاجه» and «ميزانيتك»
draw-on the green ruler
the cover card slides over B
reveal the week card, its second line on «اكتب»

scenes.name: الخاتمة — العودة إلى السؤال
scenes.purpose: return to the first symbol and the opening question; quiet close
scenes.visual: the two headphones from sc01, side by side; both $40 tags locked equal; the final question in two lines; series mark
motion: compare: the two $40 tags; the faded $200 pair leaves on «لم تتغيّر»
the equality line on «والسعر لم يتغيّر»
a «نعم» bubble pops on «تقول «نعم»»; the light lowers a little on «توقّف لحظة»
the pair steps away on «واسأل»
reveal the question line by line
hold
series mark
